source.author: verg
source.text: Arcades ad portas ruere et de more vetusto funereas rapuere faces; lucet via longo ordine flammarum et late discriminat agros.
source.text_original: Arcades ad portas ruere et de more vetusto / funereas rapuere faces; lucet via longo / ordine flammarum et late discriminat agros.
source.text_english: The Arcadians rushed to the gates and, according to ancient custom, seized torches for the funeral; the way glows with a long line of flames and broadly marks out the fields.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: lucet via late igne dei, donee silvas et amoena piorum deveniant camposque, ubi sol totumque per annum durat aprica dies thiasique chorique virorum carminaque et quorum populis iam nulla cupido.
reuse.text_original: lucet via late / igne dei, donee silvas et amoena piorum / deveniant camposque, ubi sol totumque per annum / durat aprica dies thiasique chorique virorum / carminaque et quorum populis iam nulla cupido.
reuse.text_english: The way shines broadly with the fire of God, until they reach the woods and the pleasant fields of the righteous, and the plains where the sun lasts all year long and the day is warm, and the thiasi and dances of men and songs, and of which peoples now have no desire.
